title: Validate human review feedback asset references at submit time
goal: PROBLEM: A human can submit review feedback (or a rejection) that references a screenshot such as ![image.png](assets/image.png) without the file ever being attached to the task, and can even submit image-only feedback with no text at all. Downstream agents then run a full pipeline loop (In Progress, tests, reviews) guessing at visual feedback they cannot see; the MISSING-ASSET prompt warning only tells them they are blind, it does not recover the lost information. FIX: Validate feedback at submit time in the review UI (and any API path that accepts human feedback): parse markdown references to assets/* (and other attachment paths); if a referenced file is not attached, block the submit (or show an explicit warning requiring confirm) offering to attach the file or convert to text-only feedback; and require a text description when the feedback contains only images. Keep the existing materialization + MISSING-ASSET warning as the backstop for legacy tasks. ACCEPTANCE: (1) submitting feedback that references a non-attached assets/* file is blocked or explicitly confirmed with the missing filename named; (2) image-only feedback cannot be submitted without a text description; (3) existing tasks with dead references still get the MISSING-ASSET warning. PRIOR ART: task b31cab50 (materialize attachments into the runner workspace + warn when missing) covers the downstream half; this ticket covers the upstream submit-time half it left open. CASE STUDY: KainBain task cf4b6847-11eb-4d59-b39e-e31b31df1150 (per-pipeline base branch): the 2026-11-20 Final review rejection reason was literally just '![image.png](assets/image.png)', the file never materialized, pr-review-20261120-183718.md records that agents worked blind on the UI complaint ('There seems to be no way to edit this in the ui'), and the MISSING-ASSET notice persisted all the way into the retrospective stage. See docs/tasks/cf4b6847-11eb-4d59-b39e-e31b31df1150/.
